decisions.briefing: Markets were mildly positive today (NASDAQ +0.6%, S&P 500 +0.3%) with no strong risk-on signal. Cash on hand ($389.29) sits below the $500 deployment threshold, so per prior lessons we're holding rather than forcing a buy into a neutral tape.

market_education.summary_en: Broad indices drifted modestly higher today, with the NASDAQ outpacing the S&P 500 slightly, but the move lacked the volume and breadth typically seen on strong risk-on days. Without a clear catalyst, the gains reflect steady buying rather than a decisive shift in sentiment. This kind of low-conviction grind is common between major economic data releases or earnings catalysts.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤走勢溫和向上，納斯達克指數升幅略高於標普500指數，但成交量和參與廣度都未達到典型的「風險偏好」交易日水準。在缺乏明確催化劑的情況下，這波漲幅更像是穩定買盤，而非市場情緒的明顯轉向。這種低信心度的緩步上揚，在重大經濟數據或財報公布之間的空檔期相當常見。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Dry powder refers to cash kept on the sidelines, ready to deploy when a strong opportunity appears. Holding cash isn't a failure to act — it's a deliberate choice to wait for higher-conviction setups instead of forcing trades on an average day.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指的是留在場邊、等待時機的現金部位。持有現金並不代表沒有行動，而是刻意等待更高信心度的進場機會，而不是在平淡的交易日勉強出手。
